data.promptProse: Inside a steam-filled private cedar hot spring, Michiru pushes her partner against the wooden rim and tangles her fingers into his hair for a fervent kiss. Warm lantern light shimmers across the rising vapor and wet skin.
data.animaCaption: Pressing her partner back against the steaming cedar hot-spring ledge, she threads both hands into his hair for a deep kiss while her untied violet string bikini slips loose into the water.
